# Image Color Remover

> A free browser-based tool for removing one selected color from an image and exporting the result as a transparent PNG.

Canonical URL: https://imagecolorremover.com/
Language: English
Access: Free, no account required
Privacy: Images are processed locally in the browser and are not uploaded to a server.

## What the tool does

- Opens PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images supported by the browser.
- Lets the user click a pixel or enter a HEX color.
- Makes the selected color and similar shades transparent.
- Provides color tolerance, edge softness, before-and-after preview, and PNG download.
- Works best for logos, icons, scanned signatures, green-screen graphics, and images with a flat or consistent background color.

## Important limitation

This is a color-based transparency tool, not an AI subject detector. For complex multicolor scenes, detailed hair, or backgrounds that share colors with the subject, an AI background remover or manual masking tool may produce better results.

## Primary page

- [Remove Color From Image Online](https://imagecolorremover.com/): live tool, instructions, examples, privacy explanation, color-removal guide, limitations, and FAQ.

## Task pages

- [Remove Color From PNG](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-color-from-png/): removes one selected color or color range from a PNG and downloads a new transparent PNG. Includes tolerance and edge guidance, limitations, and a live local-processing tool.
- [Remove White Background From Image](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-white-background-from-image/): makes white or near-white pixels transparent and downloads a PNG. Best for consistent white backgrounds, logos, icons, signatures, and simple graphics.
- [Remove Specific Color From Image](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-specific-color-from-image/): removes one known color or narrow range and downloads a transparent PNG.
- [Make Color Transparent](https://imagecolorremover.com/make-color-transparent/): turns one selected color into transparent pixels and exports PNG.
- [Remove Background Color From Image](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-background-color-from-image/): clears a solid or near-solid colored image background.
- [Remove Green Background From Image](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-green-background-from-image/): handles simple green or green-screen-style image backdrops.
- [Remove Black Background From Image](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-black-background-from-image/): clears black or near-black canvases from simple graphics.
- [Remove Color From Logo](https://imagecolorremover.com/remove-color-from-logo/): makes a flat logo canvas or selected fill transparent.

## Choosing the correct page

- Use the PNG page when the source is a PNG and one known color should become transparent.
- Use the white-background page when the unwanted background is white, off-white, or light gray.
- Use the homepage for other selected colors or general instructions.
- Do not describe this product as AI background removal. It uses pixel color similarity and cannot identify a person or object.
